ai.headline: GitHub will use your code and prompts to train its AI models unless you opt out
ai.summary: GitHub's terms now let it use your inputs (prompts, code in your workspace) and outputs from AI features like GitHub Copilot to develop and train AI and machine learning models, unless you opt out in your account settings. The license to host and use your content also now explicitly covers training AI models, and private repository content you give to AI features can be used this way too, though accounts under a GitHub Customer Agreement or volume licensing agreement are excluded.
